newsitem.title: FRANCE: French new car sales up 85.7 pct in September - CCFA.
newsitem.headline: French new car sales up 85.7 pct in September - CCFA.

text.p: New car sales in France rose 85.7 percent in September over the year-earlier level, the French carmakers' association CCFA said on Tuesday.

It said new car sales rose to 216,492 last month from 116,585 in September 1995 as buyers scrambled to make their purchases ahead of the expiry on September 30 of a new-cars-for-old state rebate offer.
For the first nine months of the year, new car sales in France were 13.6 percent higher.
